channel.title: INSIGHT BRIEF — Independent economics & investigative research magazine
channel.description: An independent research webzine that tracks the economy and finance, trade and raw materials, AI and tech, and disaster and safety through data and interviews. It is an independent media outlet, not a registered internet newspaper.

item.title: Ten million downloads, eight days, one refusal — the first border for AI agents
item.description: Meta launched its personal AI agent Muse in the UK on 24 November. Downloads passed 10 million after the US launch. Four UK regulators sent ministers a joint letter eight days earlier telling firms to talk to them before launch, and three of them issued statements on launch day. Meta declined the FCA's offer to test Muse together in its sandbox.

item.title: Anatomy of Dominance 58.8% — The space left by Bitcoin was filled by the dollar, not alts
item.description: Bitcoin dominance fell from 60.61% on November 12 to 58.76% on the 26th. During the same period, the altcoin season index rose from 49 to 58, but is 17 points short of the baseline of 75. If you follow where the proportion has shifted, you will find stablecoins, not Ethereum or altcoins.

item.title: Ten weeks become thirty, six months become thirty — the AI build-out queues in three layers
item.description: In the 2026 semiconductor supply chain survey by SEMI and McKinsey, substrate material lead times went from 10 weeks to 30 and assembly and packaging equipment from 23 weeks to 37. In the substrate chain some processing equipment now takes 30 months after a purchase order instead of six, and the Japanese precision parts inside that equipment take half a year. Samsung Electro-Mechanics' new Sejong line, backed by 6.78 trillion won, starts mass production in September 2028.

item.title: The application says 500 million tonnes. The announcement has no number — what holds nickel at $15,000 is 79,266 tonnes in Busan and Gwangyang
item.description: Indonesian miners applied to dig more than 500 million wet tonnes in 2027, and the government closed applications on 15 November without publishing a figure. A quota cuts ore, not refined nickel, because smelters import Philippine ore. LME three-month nickel fell from $16,230 on 13 November to $15,210 on 25 November, and 79,266 tonnes of the 275,604 tonnes in LME warehouses sit in Busan and Gwangyang.

item.title: No standard requires the mat to switch itself off — 2,354 fires in five years, 37 deaths
item.description: Fires from electric heating mats and electric heaters killed 37 people and injured 219 in five years, 2,354 fires in all. Of the 532 mat fires attributed to carelessness, 87% were recorded as 'use or installation'. Yet safety standard KC 60335-2-17 fixes the heating wire and surface temperatures in numbers and does not require a device that cuts the power after a set time. After certification, the only window onto whether a product is still the product that was certified is the market survey each winter — and every year electric underblankets and mats are caught in it.

item.title: 3.25% does not arrive today — December 15 at 3 p.m., and then your own reset date
item.description: The Bank of Korea raised its policy rate from 3.00% to 3.25%. But the day an existing variable-rate borrower feels that decision is not today. The bank's funding cost enters the benchmark index through a Dec 15 disclosure, and a borrower's rate is recalculated only when the reset date written into the contract comes around. In the meantime, the five-year fixed rate has fallen below the variable rate.

item.title: Section 301 Overcapacity Tariffs: What the 14-Economy Rate Card Adds, and Where It Does Not
item.description: USTR named 14 economies that supplied about 60% of US goods imports in 2025 and floated duties from 10% to 40%. The 'net of' clauses, the exemptions and one hearing in January decide what any importer actually pays.

item.title: 97.8% and 63.0% — the AI that gets it right once and the AI that gets it right sixteen times
item.description: Google DeepMind published Humanity's First Exam (HFE) on Kaggle on November 24, 2026: 544 prompts about counting and reading, not hard problems, grouped into 136 families. The top five models score 96% to 98% on a single attempt, but under a rule that needs all sixteen attempts in a family to be right they average 85.8%. The gap runs from 7.6 to 80.1 points, and no Korean model is on the board.

item.title: Iron ore is at $86.9, a four-year low — but coking coal at $273 is what pushed the blast furnace's raw-material bill back up
item.description: On 17 November Singapore iron ore fell to $86.9 a tonne, its lowest in almost four years. Chinese ports hold 153.75 million tonnes, only 10% of blast furnaces are profitable, and Guinea has overtaken South Africa and Canada as the third-largest exporter. Yet POSCO's third-quarter iron ore price fell 11% to $85 while coking coal rose 4% to $248. The benchmark being negotiated for 2027 is the same one Korean blast furnaces price against.

item.title: Ten days of leave expire on Dec 31 — one letter sent in July decides whether they are worth 1,148,320 won
item.description: The leave accrued this year expires in 35 days. If the employer did not send a written demand inside the window set by Article 61 of the Labor Standards Act — the ten days after the six-month mark, July 1-10 this year — the unused days are not leave the company extinguished but wages the worker can claim for three years. Since Oct 8, 2026, the statutory penalty for unpaid wages has risen to up to five years in prison or a 50 million won fine.

item.title: Coin taxation pushed to January 2029, all that remains is December 9 and ‘Is it 3 or 5 years?’
item.description: On November 5, the government announced that it would postpone virtual asset income taxation by two years to January 2029 and pursue a three-year carryover deduction for losses. On November 17, it was agreed to maintain the basic deduction of 2.5 million won, but the legal effective date is still January 1, 2027. The regular National Assembly ends on December 9, and the plenary session is scheduled for December 1, 2, and 9.

item.title: 4,053,137 won and 11,042,071 won — the AI price table only hardens in 2028
item.description: The Korea AI and Software Industry Association (KOSA) published an 'AI Project Pricing Reference (Draft)' on Nov 24. It maps 18 AI jobs onto the 17 existing rows of average SW technician wages: an AI test engineer lands in the IT tester row (4,053,137 won a month) and an AI quality-verification specialist in the IT quality manager row (11,042,071 won), though both work the same verification stage. The guide takes them in only in 2028, while the 2027 government AI budget of 16.4 trillion won is being tendered already.

item.title: 5% for India, 2% for China — while prices rise, Europe-bound cargo is being registered at customs
item.description: In November Formosa Plastics lifted PVC to $1,020 a tonne for India and $880 for China. In the same weeks, since 27 October, EU customs has been registering Korean PVC tonne by tonne. Europe takes 35.1% of Korea's PVC exports. The injury-elimination level in the complaint is 53%.

item.title: 4,697.51 — down 50.22% from the peak, and the sidecar rang 102 times
item.description: KOSPI closed at 4,697.51 on 25 November 2026, down 6.16% and its lowest close in more than ten months. The intraday low sat 50.22% below the 19 June peak, the fourth time since 2000 that the index has halved from a high. Sidecars were triggered 102 times this year and 43 sessions moved more than 5%. Individuals net bought 1.42 trillion won, while the credit-loan balance still stood at 25.88 trillion won.

item.title: Profit zone 43.6%, lowest since February 2019 — This is the first time this number has been shown above the realized price
item.description: On November 20, the supply of Bitcoin profit section fell to 43.6%. It is lower than during the crash in March 2020 and the bear market in November 2022. However, three times in the past, the number came out when the price was below the realized price, and this time it came out 11% above the realized price. Spot ETF net outflows of $4.71 billion in November appear to have made the difference.

item.title: 80 mandatory, 148 checks — the keyboard reaches the checklist in February 2027
item.description: The Ministry of the Interior and Safety distributed its Public AI Service UI/UX Guidelines to central and local governments and public institutions on Nov 25. They carry 29 design criteria, 99 detailed requirements (80 mandatory) and 148 checklist items, but accessibility criteria such as button descriptions and keyboard operation are added only by February 2027. Europe has enforced the same sentence as law since Aug 2.

item.title: Four days' worth of tin left in the warehouse, and the price still fell 19% — Nasdaq, not the mine, moved it
item.description: On 13 November LME tin for immediate delivery cost $790 a tonne more than the three-month contract. On 24 November it cost $75 less. In between, a kilogram went from 65,000 won to 55,000 won, and the warehouse held about four days of world consumption. When Chinese smelters restarted, the spread gave way first; the price then followed AI stocks down.

item.title: 21 dots in the Korean version of the dot plot — If three dots mark 3.75%, the loan interest rate will change in 2027
item.description: On November 26, 2026, the Monetary Policy Committee will issue a new dot plot containing the outlook for the next six months along with whether to raise the base interest rate from 3.00% to 3.25%. In August, 3.25% was the most with 10 out of 21 points. How many 3.75% are recorded this time and where the median goes will determine the upper end of treasury bond and variable loan interest rates in 2027.

item.title: Loans 5.02%, deposits 3.62% — what happened in the month when the gap narrowed by 0.10 percentage points
item.description: In October 2026, the interest rate on bank household loans was 5.02% per annum, exceeding 5% for the first time in 2 years and 11 months since November 2023. Mortgage loans are at 4.98%, the highest since March 2012. However, in the same month, deposit interest rates rose faster than loan interest rates, narrowing the new loan-deposit rate spread to 1.02% points. What does it mean that loans are rising but the gap is shrinking?

item.title: It says ‘I am an AI assistant’ — what 200,000 users’ calls are missing is a signed mandate
item.description: SK Telecom, KT, LG Uplus and Naver decided on Nov 23 to stop taking customer-service calls placed by AI agents. While calls from a service used by 200,000 people within a month of launch stall at identity checks, the payments market introduced cryptographically signed mandates in September 2025.
